event.description: AT-URI of the event to configure.

rsvpRedirectUrl.description: URL to redirect users to for external ticketing (e.g., ti.to, eventbrite).

disableDirectRsvp.description: When true, the RSVP button redirects to an external ticketing URL instead of creating a direct RSVP.

requireConfirmedEmail.description: When true, RSVPs require a confirmed email address.

errors.name: EventNotFound
errors.description: The specified event does not exist.

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: The authenticated user does not own this event.

errors.name: InvalidRedirectUrl
errors.description: The provided redirect URL is invalid or not allowed.

main.description: Configure Smoke Signal specific settings for an event. Requires authentication and ownership of the event.
